Configured Windows PE consumption and container announcement source
================================================================

These are offline executable sources, not translation examples or test output.
reference/classic-consumption-native-ROLE.c contain actual Ghidra 12.1.4 C.
Their original instructions, conditional branches, direct calls and literal
operands are retained in the matching .asm files and consumption-native-*.tsv.
The two images are the configured native-pe-images.json sources:
  reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000
  classic   PE:6a70b91c:0270a000

Complete source owners
----------------------
role                 reference RVA       classic RVA
fill-item            8360a0..83690c       833920..83418c
heat-liquid          836b20..837145       8343a0..8349c5
fill-liquid          837150..837e97       8349d0..835717
empty-item           894b00..8951ab       892380..892a2b
remove-empty-item    8956d0..895f15       892f50..893795
consume              895fd0..897525       893850..894da5

Each owner's full unwind extent is retained, including ordinary C++ string
capacity/allocator/error branches. These six owners contain conditional direct
edges but no bounded indirect selector tables; the switches manifest therefore
has a header and no rows. A native branch is not equivalent to another message:
the complete emitted text productions are in native-productions.tsv.

consume
-------
The item parameter is passed to c65450(item, string, 0, -1). The producer appends
its final period after the whole caption and submits the result to e3c20:
  You eat the ITEM.
  You drink the ITEM.
  You lick the ITEM.
The condition branches additionally emit:
  The ITEM is too salty.
  The ITEM is too hot.
  The ITEM is too cold.
  No.  That's disgusting.
  You just can't fit any more.
  It's too much!  You feel even more sick.
  It's too much!  You might not be able to keep it down.
  You feel really full.
  You are starting to feel full.

The rejection threshold reads unit+0x994 (>=250000). Successful eating or
drinking sets a common full-state branch at >=200000 and a starting-full branch
at >=100000. The prior fullness and sickness field select the two complete
overfull sentences, or the two ordinary fullness sentences. Actual condition
edges and flag-mask branches remain in consumption-native-branches.tsv.
Null item and disabled-announcement branches emit no corresponding text.
The compound overfull messages contain native double spaces after '!'. Existing
normalization of ordinary prose whitespace owns those doubles; no new wording
is inferred from independently extracted vector chunks.

fill-item / fill-liquid
-----------------------
  You fill your CONTAINER with CONTENTS.
  Your CONTAINER is already full.
  It won't fit in your CONTAINER.
  CONTENTS is empty.                   [fill-item only]

The fill-item branch moves or splits actual contained items and gives the two
complete c65450 captions to the common constructor. The empty/full/no-capacity
branches have independent native predicates and complete messages.

The fill-liquid CONTENTS field is the complete native material state name.
It may prepend deposited contaminants (including a material owner's personal
name and possessive), and independently adds "stagnant " and "salt " for water.
The material describer also has its real "unknown material" branch. Preserve
all of this field through $announcement-substance; do not split it into words.

heat-liquid
-----------
  The CONTENTS is hot enough already.
  You heat the CONTENTS.
  You heat the CONTENTS to no effect.

empty-item / remove-empty-item
------------------------------
  You empty ITEM.
  You drop ITEM.
  You empty the ITEM.
  You take out the ITEM.
  You take off ITEM.

Fish inventory caption provenance
--------------------------------
The existing actual Ghidra source in
  ../announcement-combat-native/reference-a82c10.c
contains the common native item-type constructor for this same configured PE.
case 0x31 (FISH) and case 0x32 (FISH_RAW) are complete sources. They select:
  optional "rotten "
  "raw " for FISH_RAW
  generic "fish" when race is absent, otherwise caste-name with RAW-name fallback
  sex==0: ", " + byte 0x0c (female)
  sex==1: ", " + byte 0x0b (male)
  other sex: no suffix
  quantity >1: " [" + decimal quantity + "]"
The exact sex append instructions are reference a870d5..a870fa; the shared
quantity append instructions are a88077..a880a1. The count belongs to the item
caption, before the consume producer's final '.', not to the report's repeat
field. The c65450 caller additionally retains the complete item's designation,
quality and wear marks. Its actual C is retained alongside a82c10 above.

Translation path and the screenshot's missing fish
-------------------------------------------------
$announcement-item -> translate_item_caption_grammar -> native_text_to_utf8
 -> ::items -> %item_designation:with_number -> fish/fish_raw plus $number.
fish.toml and fish_raw.toml already contain caste-only, F/M and Unicode sex
productions; their caste namespace already supplies sole -> 鳎鱼.
item_number_suffix preserves the native numeric suffix. item_designation.h
preserves native 0x0b/0x0c while unwrapping marked items. Inventory's native
fish parser likewise owns sex/count together, so no fish-specific word rule or
bare-article consumption variant is needed.

The announcement display-source normalizer had used C isspace() for its rich
text append step. C treats the native sex bytes as vertical-tab/form-feed, so
this step changed the complete fish item into "sole, [9]" before the typed
parser saw it. The shared normalizer now uses native_prose_space(), preserving
both sex glyphs while still folding space/tab/CR/LF. The common fix applies to
all item species, sexes, counts and designation wrappers in these records.

Data ownership
--------------
All existing native productions continue to use their existing typed rules.
The consumption source manifest also retains the complete literal
  You just can't fit any more. -> 你实在吃喝不下更多了。
The adventure catalog uses the exact existing ui-messages.tsv translation,
with its source address in adventure-announcement-sources.tsv. No image-derived English production was
added to the grammar. No game process, desktop, tests or deployment were run
by this extraction work; game display after the shared change is unobserved.

Reproduction
------------
Use the workspace's fixed Python to run tools/extract_adventure_consumption_sources.py.
Import each configured PE into a separate Ghidra temporary project with
-noanalysis -scriptPath D:/workspace/dfcn/tools and post-script
DecompileAdventureConsumption.java SOURCE_DIRECTORY reference|classic.
The script consumes the retained function extents, instruction boundaries,
supplier entries, branches and literals without launching the game.
An independent application.settingsdir avoids the machine's existing OSGi
cache startup problem. Generated analysis caches are not source material.
